responsibility: Implements the small documentation generator that emits the Texinfo manual fragment for the RISC-V `-mcpu=` option. It reads the declarative CPU table in `riscv-cores.def` through the `RISCV_CORE` macro, collects the user-visible core names, and prints the corresponding `@opindex mcpu`/`@item` text listing valid processor strings, making it the manual-generation companion for concrete CPU-name documentation rather than option parsing or tuning logic.
